card.name: Inside long capitalized warning words
card.fires_on: A single letter or short piece in the middle of a long word written in capitals, mostly in boxed warning headings. Typical cases are EXACERBATION, EMBRYO-FETAL and AGGRAVATE.

modes.label: Capitalized warning terms
modes.description: Split pieces inside all-caps words in boxed warning titles, such as the B in EXACERBATION.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATIONS OF HEPATITIS B

modes.label: Embryo-fetal toxicity
modes.description: The O inside EMBRYO before -FETAL in warning headings.
modes.example: WARNING: DIARRHEA AND EMBRY<<O>>-FETAL TOXICITY Z

modes.label: Other mid-word pieces
modes.description: Pieces inside less common words, in lowercase or mixed case.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Transf<<us>>ional Iron Overload: Initial dose for

card.writes: It slightly favors words like always and aggressive, but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires inside long all-caps words in warning headings, such as EXACERBATION, before the word is finished.
